title: "DtMF" Extends All-Time Hot Latin Songs Record to 59 Consecutive Weeks at No. 1 — Chart Dated May 16, 2026
detail: The Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart dated May 16, 2026 marks 'DtMF' (Debí Tirar Más Fotos) at its 59th consecutive week at No. 1, extending the all-time chart record that Bad Bunny first broke on the chart dated May 2, 2026 (57 weeks, surpassing Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee's 'Despacito' at 56). The song, released January 23, 2025 as the title track from the album of the same name, has now spent nearly 14 months commanding the top of Billboard's Hot Latin Songs — the longest No. 1 run in the chart's 60+ year history. Blending plena rhythms with trap and reggaeton, the track's lyric about preserving family memories through photography took on a life far beyond its recording, anchoring an entire cultural movement that spans two Studio Albums Of The Year awards (Latin Grammy + Grammy), a Super Bowl halftime show, a world tour that will shortly extend into European stadiums, and a film in pre-production set in 19th-century Puerto Rico. The European leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour opens in six days at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (May 22–23, sold out), Bad Bunny's first European stadium shows in six years.
